metadata.purpose: Core APS witness: G2 + FP-synt without FG2. Algebraic analogue of BS16.
metadata.theorem: exists p(p=boxtimes p) + G2 does NOT imply FG2
metadata.long_description: G2=T FG2=F FP=T. CORE MODEL. G2 holds, primitive boxtimes-FP exists, FG2 fails. This is the abstract analogue of the Beklemishev-Shamkanov 2016 result: a system can have a Jeroslow-style fixed point p=boxtimes(p) and satisfy G2, yet fail FG2 (formalized second incompleteness). The FP is at bot: boxtimes(bot)=bot. G2 holds vacuously (boxtimes(T)=c not <=bot). FG2 fails: boxtimes^2(T)=T not <=c=boxtimes(T).
